method: Happy DOM simulation executing actual app.js, preview.js, and background.js

checks.name: Sample cart and every principal view render through actual app event handlers
Sample mutations persist locally and do not leak into the empty workspace
Manual add, item quantity, editing, and saved-for-later use the same background service
Fractional quantities are rejected and rendered values recover after the failed change
Checked offers rank exact variants while missing costs and conflicts remain visible
Watch settings produce price-drop and restock transitions and avoid duplicate alerts
Manual order creation and delivery status edits persist safe tracking details
Payment planner renders full obligation, calendar dates, and exact remainder cents
Preferences save and backup export serializes the real workspace
Hostile user text and active URLs cannot become injected product UI
Malformed imports leave current data intact and sample backups remain isolated
Removing a product deletes its related offers, history, alerts, and orders

limitations: No Chrome installation, activeTab permission, side-panel lifecycle, desktop notification delivery, CSS layout, or browser download behavior is verified by this suite.
